

{{infobox Chinese|l=Yin Metal Rabbit|kanji=辛卯|romaji=kanoto usagi|onyomi=shinbō|p=xīmǎo|w=hsin-mao|mi=ɕin⁵³ mɑʊ̯|y=san1 maau5|j=san1 maau5|ci=sɐn maːu̯|mc=sin maw|oc-bs=sin maw}}
{{Sexagenary cycle}}
'''Yin Metal Rabbit''' (辛卯, ''kanoto usagi''; onyomi ''shinbō'') is the 28th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|af|Sestigdelige siklus|ar|دورة ستينية|arz|دوره ستينيه|as|ষাঠি বছৰীয়া আৱৰ্তন|ast|Ciclu sexaxenariu|bn|ষাটবার্ষিক চক্র|ca|Cicle sexagesimal|cdo|Găng-ciĕ|cs|Kan-č’|de|60-Jahre-Zyklus|eo|Ĉina sesdekjara ciklo|es|Ciclo sexagesimal chino|eu|Hirurogeitaka urteko ziklo|fa|چرخه شصت‌تایی|fr|Cycle sexagésimal chinois|hak|Kôn-chṳ̂|hy|Վաթսունամյա շրջան|id|Ganzhi|it|Ganzhi|ja|干支|ka|სამოცეული ციკლი|ko|간지|mk|Шеесетгодишен циклус|ms|Ganzhi|nn|Sekstiårig syklus|no|Sekstiårig syklus|ru|Система гань-чжи|sh|Seksagenarni ciklus|simple|Sexagenary cycle|su|Daur séksagenari|sv|Himmelska stammar och jordiska grenar|th|แผนภูมิสวรรค์|tr|Altmışlık döngü|uk|Шістдесятирічний цикл|vi|Can Chi|wuu|干支|xmf|გან-ჩჟიშ სისტემა|za|Gancei|zh|干支|zh_classical|干支|zh_min_nan|Kan-chi|zh_yue|干支|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 28th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yang Metal Tiger|ja|庚寅}} and followed by {{ill|Yang Water Dragon|af|Waterdraak (astrologie)|cdo|Ìng-sìng|de|Wasser-Drache|fr|Dragon d'eau (astrologie)|hak|Ngìm-sìn|ja|壬辰|ko|임진|nds|Water-Draken|vi|Nhâm Thìn|za|Nyaemzsaenz|zh|壬辰|zh_min_nan|Jîm-sîn|zh_yue|壬辰|qid=Q1062581}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|af|Hemelstam|ca|Troncs celestes|cdo|Tiĕng-găng|de|Himmelsstämme|es|Troncos celestiales|fa|شاخه‌های آسمانی|fi|Taivaalliset rungot|fr|Tige céleste|gan|天干|hak|Thiên-kôn|id|Batang Langit|it|Tronco celeste|ja|十干|ko|천간|mk|Небесни стебла|ms|Tiangan|nl|Hemelse Stammen|pl|Niebiańskie pnie|ru|Небесные стволы|tr|Göksel Gövdeler|uk|Небесні стовбури|za|Diengan|zh|天干|zh_min_nan|Thian-kan|zh_yue|天干|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} ''辛'' is Yin Metal, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|af|Aardtak|als|Erdzweige|az|Türk-monqol təqvimi|ca|Branques terrestres|cdo|Dê-ciĕ|de|Erdzweige|fa|شاخه‌های زمینی|fi|Maalliset oksat|fr|Branche terrestre|gan|地支|hak|Thi-chṳ̂|id|Cabang Bumi|it|Ramo terrestre|ja|十二支|ko|지지 (역법)|mk|Земски гранки|ms|Dizhi|pl|Ziemskie gałęzie|ru|Земные ветви|tr|12 hayvanlı takvim|ug|12 مۆچەل تەقۋىمى|uk|Земні гілки|za|Deihcei|zh|地支|zh_min_nan|Tē-chi|zh_yue|地支|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch}} ''卯'' (Rabbit) is Yin Wood; together they form a Mutual Destruction relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|af|Wu Xing|ar|نظرية العناصر الخمسة|bcl|Wu Xing|ca|Cinc processos (Wuxing)|cdo|Ngū-hèng|cs|Pět prvků|da|De fem faser|de|Fünf-Elemente-Lehre|el|Ου Σιν|eo|Skolo de la kvin elementoj|es|Wu Xing|et|Viie elemendi õpetus|fa|وو شینگ|fi|Viisi elementtiä|fr|Wuxing (cosmologie)|gan|五行|hak|Ńg-hàng|he|חמשת היסודות|hu|Öt elem (kínai)|hy|Ու Սին|id|Wu Xing|it|Wu Xing|ja|五行思想|ko|오행|lt|Using|mk|Пет елементи|ms|Wu Xing|nl|Wu Xing|no|De fem elementene|oc|Cinc elements (Wuxing)|pl|Wu xing|pt|Wu Xing|ro|Wu Xing|ru|У-син|simple|Five elements|sk|Učenie o piatich živloch|sl|Pet elementov (vušing)|sq|Wuxing (filozofia kineze)|sr|Пет космичких усмерења|sv|De fem elementen (wu xing)|tl|Limang elemento|tr|Beş element|uk|У-сін|vi|Ngũ hành|wuu|五行|za|Nguxhengz|zh|五行|zh_classical|陰陽五行|zh_min_nan|Ngó͘-hêng|zh_yue|五行|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing}}.

==Months of Yin Metal Rabbit==
In years where the last digit is 1 or 6 (corresponding to the {{ill|Heavenly Stems|af|Hemelstam|ca|Troncs celestes|cdo|Tiĕng-găng|de|Himmelsstämme|es|Troncos celestiales|fa|شاخه‌های آسمانی|fi|Taivaalliset rungot|fr|Tige céleste|gan|天干|hak|Thiên-kôn|id|Batang Langit|it|Tronco celeste|ja|十干|ko|천간|mk|Небесни стебла|ms|Tiangan|nl|Hemelse Stammen|pl|Niebiańskie pnie|ru|Небесные стволы|tr|Göksel Gövdeler|uk|Небесні стовбури|za|Diengan|zh|天干|zh_min_nan|Thian-kan|zh_yue|天干|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} {{ill|Kanoto (辛)|ja|辛|lt=Kanoto (辛)}} or {{ill|Hinoe (丙)|ja|丙|lt=Hinoe (丙)}}), the {{ill|February|en|February|qid=Q109|lt=February}} of that year is considered a Yin Metal Rabbit month. However, this applies to the {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦}}, and in some cases, the {{ill|Solar term|af|Sontermyn|ar|فصل شمسي|ast|Términos solares|cdo|Cáik-ké|cs|24 ťie-čchi|eo|Suna Periodo|es|Términos solares|fr|Période solaire|hak|Chiet-hì|he|תקופות חמה (לוח השנה הסיני)|id|Posisi matahari|ja|二十四節気|ko|절기|ms|Jieqi|ro|Termen solar|th|ภาวะ (ปฏิทินจีน)|tr|Güneş dönemi|vi|Tiết khí|wuu|節氣|za|Cietheiq|zh|节气|zh_classical|節氣|zh_min_nan|Cheh-khùi|zh_yue|節氣|qid=Q1190993|lt=Solar term}} (from {{ill|Jingzhe|af|Jingzhe|cdo|Gĭng-dĭk|fr|Jingzhe|hak|Kiang-chhít|id|Jingzhe|ja|啓蟄|ko|경칩|sv|Jingzhe|vi|Kinh trập|za|Gingcig|zh|惊蛰|zh_classical|驚蟄|zh_min_nan|Keⁿ-ti̍t|zh_yue|驚蟄|qid=Q1306596|lt=Jingzhe}} to the day before {{ill|Qingming (solar term)|af|Qingming|cdo|Chĭng-mìng|eo|Sereno|hak|Chhîn-mìn|id|Qingming|ja|清明|ko|청명|no|Qingming|sv|Qingming|vi|Thanh minh|wuu|清明|za|Cingmingz|zh|清明|zh_classical|清明|zh_min_nan|Chheng-bêng|zh_yue|清明|qid=Q1680269|lt=Qingming}}) is used.

==Days of Yin Metal Rabbit==
=== Selection Days ===
Yin Metal Rabbit days are the 8th day of the {{ill|Ten directions|ja|十方暮|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11405067}} cycle.
